description: BILLABLE: creates a paid video task (POST /v1/videos) charged per second to the user's APIKO balance. Only call after estimate_cost on the same input and the user's explicit approval of the model, duration, resolution and cost. Reference videos add billed seconds. Returns a task_id at once; poll with get_task (videos take minutes). Never call again to check progress.

client_request_id.description: Your id for this one approved request (8-96 chars of letters, digits, . _ -). Reusing it with the same input returns the earlier task instead of charging twice.

input.description: Model request fields exactly as listed in get_model input_schema (e.g. {"prompt": "...", "resolution": "2k"}). Leave out model and async.

max_cost_usd.description: Budget the user approved; the call is refused if the estimate (or its upper bound) is higher or cannot be computed.

prompt.description: Shortcut for input.prompt; give the prompt once.

reference_video_seconds.description: Total reference video length, for the cost check only; not sent.

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait (default 0; videos take minutes, use get_task).

name: generate_video
title: Generate a video (billable)
